text:
**My pick for most iPhone drivers is the Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W vent mount.** If you want the fastest charging, get the Anker Prime. For the best value, get the ESR HaloLock.

**Top picks**

1. **Belkin BoostCharge Magnetic Wireless Car Vent Mount (Qi2, 15W), about $47.99.** Three guides pick it as best overall. It includes a 27W car adapter and a 1 m USB-C cable, and it rotates between portrait and landscape. It fits vent slats up to 3 mm thick and 20 mm deep, and vertical slats may droop. ([RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/))

2. **Anker Prime Qi2 25W with active cooling, $89.99 list (listed at $69.99 in one roundup).** This is the fastest option, with thermoelectric cooling plus a fan to limit heat throttling. The sources disagree on the adapter. Two say a 60W adapter is in the box, while another says you need your own 45W+ adapter, so check the listing. It isn't compatible with Tesla or Mercedes-Benz vents. Only newer iPhones can use the full 25W: the 16 Pro Max, 16 Plus and 17 get up to 25W, and the 15 and earlier get about 15W. ([MountGuys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/), [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/))

3. **ESR HaloLock 15W with CryoBoost fan, best value.** It's Qi2-certified and mounts on a vent or the dashboard. The fan helps keep the phone from throttling in hot cars. The car adapter may not be included, so budget $10 to $15 more. Prices vary by seller: ESR's own store lists $39.99, and one roundup lists $18.99 on Amazon. ESR's store link is [here](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost). It's an affiliate link, so the site earns a commission at no cost to you. That page also lists code PARTNER18 for $7.19 off, which it says it tested on 2026-10-22. Checkout has the final say. ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost))

**Other options**
- **LISEN Qi2.2 25W with fan, from $39.95.** A 95W adapter is included. It's a suction mount and was named best overall in one roundup. ([The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/))
- **PITAKA MagEZ Car Mount Pro 2, $59.99.** It's 15W with no fan, so it's more likely to throttle on a sunny dash.
- **Non-charging vent mount (VICSEED).** This is a simpler choice if you don't need charging. ([MountGuys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/))

**Before you buy**
- Look for **Qi2 certification**. "MagSafe-compatible" alone may mean only 7.5W.
- Check your vents. Thin, shallow or vertical slats are the usual problem. If yours are awkward, choose a dash or suction mount.
- For 25W, you need a strong USB-C car adapter (45W or more).
- Ignore "80 lb suction" or gram-force claims. Magnet quality and mount design matter more.

I couldn't open direct Belkin or Anker product pages from these results, so the links above go to the reviews I used. Which phone do you have, and is your car's vent horizontal or vertical? That would help me narrow it to one.
